+---
+## What
+Keep the in-memory graph current when the logs change on disk. The basis is plan.md §5.6 and §12 item 25.
+- `Sources/FoundationModelsKanban/Observe/BoardWatcher.swift`: an FSEvents stream with file-level events on `.kanban/` of each loaded board, for the life of `KanbanGraph`. A repo with no `.kanban/` yet: watch the repo directory until `.kanban/` appears, then load and move the watcher.
+- Batches: the changed paths of one FSEvents group go to the serial gate as one batch. Ignore a file whose signature equals the recorded signature (own writes, repeated events).
+- `Observe/LiveGraph.swift`: apply a batch in stage order with the loader work queue: changed file = read and fold again, replace the slot state; new file = new slot, resolve waiting edges; removed file = remove the node, edges become unresolved. +- `KanbanGraph.close()`: stop all watchers.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] With no subscriber, a manual edit of a task log changes the result of the next query (after the event comes in).
+- [ ] A new task file from a `git pull` makes a new task, and a `dependsOn` edge that pointed to it now resolves; a removed file removes the node.
+- [ ] After each case, the live graph equals a fresh load of the same files; the tool's own writes are not read again.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsKanbanTests/Observe/LiveGraphTests.swift`: manual edit, `union` merge lines, new file, removed file, branch switch (more than half), bad line, own write, `.kanban/` that appears later. Wait for the batch with an async expectation that has a timeout.
+- [ ] Run `swift test --filter LiveGraphTests`; expect all pass.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file

+    - Not in this card: the change feed per batch (plan.md §5.6, change feed) belongs to the Subscriptions task. `LiveGraph.apply` returns the new event ids; `CommitSession.apply(watchedPaths:)` discards them for now.
